newsitem.title: USA: BT Financial unit completes branch purchase.
newsitem.headline: BT Financial unit completes branch purchase.

text.p: BT Financial Corp said Monday its affiliate, Johnstown Bank and Trust Co, completed the purchase of three branches of National City Bank of Pennsylvania, a subsidiary of National City Corp of Cleveland for undisclosed terms.
The sale includes the deposits, loans and fixed assets of the three branches. The combined deposit total for the three offices is approximately $70 million.
With the completion of this acquisition, BT said its total assets will be approximately $1.57 billion.
The branches are located in Meyersdale, Salisbury and Everett in Pennsylvania.
BT, headquartered in Johnstown, Pennsylvania, is a bank holding company whose affiliates include Johnstown Bank and Trust Co, Fayette Bank and Laurel Bank.
